recommendations.title: Turn the OpenReply patch into a verified fact — or quarantine it
recommendations.reason: This is no longer just a stale-worktree concern. Static inspection found an undefined commentId reference and a follower branch that appears to send once directly and then fall through into the normal send path. That can mean typecheck failure, duplicate reward DMs, and broken quota accounting. The production site is healthy because this local diff is not proven deployed; leaving it unverified preserves risk and makes every future OpenReply change harder to reason about.
